subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding that a stock's price can go up or down based on how well the company is doing and other factors
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student tracks a simulated stock price over several rounds based on described company news events
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a company event (good news, bad news) to its likely effect on stock price
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a stock's price isn't fixed and can change over time

misconception_flags: believes a stock's price stays fixed once purchased

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
